descriptive_success: target RMSE <= 0.9 times minimum comparator RMSE, best comparator strictly positive; unrounded values
uncertainty: No calibrated CI or significance claim; finite sensitivity scenarios only
replicate_scope: Six separately deposited pooled libraries; culture/extraction independence, pooling semantics and RNA/DNA pairing unresolved. Unpaired conditional library-level reproduction only.
normalization: Mean log2 RNA counts plus pseudocount minus mean log2 DNA counts plus pseudocount, followed by within-field subtraction of deposited reference
exposure: All three DNA libraries already inspected for sequence/coverage eligibility; no RNA outcomes opened before freeze
interpretation: Held-out RNA-library reproduction conditional on inspected DNA, same 32 genotypes and reference-protein context
secondary_endpoints: maximum endpoint-relative barrier across all 496 pairs
failure_rules: no outcome-dependent exclusions or pseudocount/model changes
success_limits: No discrimination of biological interaction from persistent measurement bias
No folding mechanism or measured fitness claim
